text:
josh: Need a new GPU nodepool in europe-west4 for the recommendation service.
josh: Requesting 20 H100 GPUs to start (prefer 8x H100 nodes or 4x 16x if available). Target ASG autoscale between 2-8 nodes initially.
priya: Heads-up: eu-west4 quotas are tight. We might need a quota bump for H100 GPUs and regional vCPUs. @gcp-quota-bot can you confirm current quotas? :eyes:
gcp-quota-bot: Current quotas for europe-west4: GPUs(H100): 8, GPUs(A100-80GB): 16, CPUs: 1024. Pending quota requests: none.
mike: So quota bot says only 8 H100s available. Two short options: request quota increase (lead time ~1-3 business days) or provision mixed pool with A100 fallback.
anya: For rollout speed I'd do mixed-pool: primary H100 dogfood pool (as many as quota allows) + a larger A100 pool with taints and a deployment-level toleration for non-latency-critical shards.
josh: Agree. But also need cluster-autoscaler config tuned: scale-up-delay and expander policy. Last time we had long scale-up because of pod resources and max-pods-per-node miscalc.
priya: Paste the gcloud node-pool create cmd I used previously:
priya: ```
# create H100 pool (spot fallback)
gcloud container node-pools create rec-h100-pool \
  --cluster=prod-eu-cluster \
  --machine-type=n2d-standard-32 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-h100,count=8 \
  --zone=europe-west4-a \
  --num-nodes=1 \
  --max-nodes=8 \
  --min-nodes=1 \
  --enable-autoscaling \
  --node-labels=pool=rec-h100,tier=gpu \
  --node-taints=gpu=h100:NoSchedule \
  --preemptible
```
mike: A few suggestions: 1) set --max-pods-per-node to match ENI limits, 2) attach local SSDs only if we need NVMe cache, 3) use GPU driver daemonset that tolerates taints.
anya: Also make sure kubernetes-device-plugin image matches driver version. We had issues where driverctl failed and device plugin crashed causing CA not to see capacity.
josh: Example toleration on the deployment:
josh: ```yaml
tolerations:
- key: "gpu"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "h100"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```
priya: For autoscaler flags, set --scale-down-unneeded-time to 10m and --expander=least-waste to prefer packing.
mike: For cost: H100 preemptible is ~3.2x A100-80GB on our list prices. If we keep mixed pool, add routing policy to prefer H100 for latency-sensitive and A100 for batch.
josh: Networking note: europe-west4 has MTU 1460 for GCE in that region; if any inference containers force jumbo frames we hit packet loss. Anya, can you run a quick iperf between existing gpu nodes?
anya: Running now... results: `iperf3 -c 10.10.2.5 -P 8` -> avg 9.1 Gbits/sec, jitter minimal. No jumbo frame issues found.
sre-bot: Deploy pipeline started for rec-h100-pool branch (ci-1244). Logs: `node-init -> driver-install -> device-plugin`.
priya: While quota request is open, I'll file GCP support ticket. Suggest message: request 24 additional GPU(H100) and 500 vCPUs in europe-west4; mark as high priority for production launch.
josh: Also add quota bump justification: low-latency recommendation API, expected steady-state 10k qps, latency SLO 50ms P95.
mike: One last thing: set nodepool autoscaler ignoreDaemonSets false? CA will account for daemonset pods. Also set node group scale-up-concurrency to 2 to avoid racing.
anya: I'll draft the Terraform changes for node-pools and autoscaler, and include a mixedInstancePolicy snippet for managed instance groups.
josh: Thanks team. Priya please open the quota ticket and assign to @mike for terraform review. I'll schedule a canary deploy once H100s present. :thumbsup:
priya: On it. Filing ticket and adding cost impact estimate.
mike: I'll mock the H100 capacity locally with tainted nodes to validate scheduler behavior before quota is approved.
josh: Great. Closing here once ticket ID posted.
priya: Ticket filed: GCP-84673. Priority: P2. Requested +24 H100, +500 vCPUs. ETA: 48-72 hrs for approval.
josh: Perfect, thanks."
